name: Kurashiki Akane
source:
The childhood friend of Junpei. Akane Kurashiki is her actual name, although she chooses the codename June once she accidentally reveals Junpei's name. She is a delicate girl who wants no one to be left behind during the Nonary Game. Her bracelet number is 6, from the month June.

[From [url=http://zeroescape.wikia.com/wiki/Zero_Escape:_Nine_Hours,_Nine_Persons,_Nine_Doors]Zero Escape Wikia[/url]]

[Spoiler]She is actually the true identity of Zero, and the purpose of the Nonary Game she created is to save her 12-year-old self from being burned in an incinerator.[/Spoiler]
